*
 The Police Sub-Inspector of Kempegowda nagara P.S. has filed chargesheet against Accused for the offences punishable  3  C.C.No.29421/2022 U/s.498A, 323, 504, 506 r/w/s 149 of IPC. & Sec.3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
2. The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Smt.Pallavi.
The gist of the prosecution case is that the Accused No.1 got married with CW-1 on 15-04-2019.

At the time of marriage, the accused No.1 to 6 with common object have demanded and taken 150 gms of gold ornaments for CW-1 and gold chain, gold bracelet and gold ring to accused No.1 as dowry from CW-1 and her family.

It is further Kempegowdanagar Police Station vs Mohan on 4 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163893047/
2 alleged that the accused No. 1 to 6 after the marriage with common object have subjected CW-1 to mental and physical cruelty in respect of getting a Site in her name from her parents, for giving birth to a female child and on 13-05-2022 at about 8.30 p.m., the accused persons have assaulted CW-1 causing bodily pain, abused her in filthy language with an intention to provoke CW-1 from committing breach of peace and threatened her of dire consequences and thus accused subjected CW-1 to cruelty both physically and mentally.
Based on the said information, a case in Cr.No.71/2022 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.
After completion of the investigation, the P.S.I of K G Nagara P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused for the aforesaid offences.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.
Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused entered appearance and were enlarged on bail.

The prosecution papers was furnished to the accused as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.
 4.

Before framing charge an opportunity of being heard was provided to the accused and after hearing them and the prosecution and as there was sufficient materials, the charge for the aforesaid offences was framed and same was read over to the accused in the language known to them, to which, the accused pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.
The plea of the accused was recorded.

Thereafter, the matter was set down for prosecution Kempegowdanagar Police Station vs Mohan on 4 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163893047/
3 evidence.
 5.
In order to prove the charges, the prosecution has examined PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and P.2 documents.

As there was no any incriminating evidence appearing against the accused, the recording of Statement of Accused as required U/s.
313 of Cr.P.C., was dispensed with.
6. Heard arguments on both the sides.
I have Perused the materials on record.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused persons caused physical and  mental cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry  and abused, assaulted and threatened her with dire  consequences thereby accused have committed the  offences punishable U/s.498A, 323, 504, 506 r/w/s 149  of IPC. & Sec.3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.?
 2) what order?
 8.

My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.
 Point No.2........

As per final order, for the following:
 REASONS  9.
POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.

In order to bring home the guilt of the accused,
the prosecution has examined one witness as PW-1 got marked Ex.P.1 and Ex.P2 documents.
Ex.P1 is the first information statement.
Ex.P.2 is the spot panchanama.
10. CW-1 was examined as PW-1 Smt.Pallavi.

She in her Kempegowdanagar Police Station vs Mohan on 4 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163893047/
4 examination-in-chief has deposed that her marriage with accused  6  C.C.No.29421/2022 No.1 was performed on 15-04-2019 and deposed after the marriage, accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of dowry and never abused and assaulted and threatened her with dire consequences. PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.

sentences.text: There the police have took her signatures on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.1 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2

and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her. During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.
 11. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness have turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also  7  C.C.No.29421/2022 the valuable time of the court would be saved.
As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.

In view of the material witness, turning hostile the Kempegowdanagar Police Station vs Mohan on 4 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163893047/
5 prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.

sentences.text: Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
12. POINT No.2:- For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:

ORDER In exercise of power conferred Under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C., Accused No.1 to 6 are acquitted of the offences punishable U/s.498A, 323, 504, 506 r/w/s 149 of IPC. & Sec.3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
The bail bonds of accused No.1 to 6 shall be in force for a period of 6 months.
